name: CrossSell Mailer – Post-Purchase Coupon Rules (Lite)
author: Alvaro

sections.description:
CrossSell Mailer is a WooCommerce automation tool that sends post-purchase emails with personalized coupon codes based on products the customer has bought.

Perfect for:
– 🛍️ Cross-selling
– 🔁 Repeat purchases
– 🎁 Loyalty incentives
– 🖤 Black Friday / Seasonal promotions
– 📈 Automated retention marketing

When a customer completes an order, the plugin checks your defined rule and automatically generates a unique WooCommerce coupon, inserts it into an email template, and sends it to the customer.
This helps turn every order into a new opportunity for sales.

Lite Version Limits

The Lite edition includes everything needed to start selling more — with a few limitations:

  • 1 automation rule
  • 1 trigger product
  • 1 target product
  • Basic coupon generation
  • Basic email editor

To unlock unlimited rules, unlimited products, advanced conditions, and premium email templates, upgrade to CrossSell Mailer Pro.

Features

🔧 Coupon Automation

  • Auto-create WooCommerce coupons after purchase
  • Customize discount type, amount, expiry, and usage limits
  • Smart coupon naming using variables ({{first_name}}, {{coupon_code}}, etc.)

🛍️ Product-Based Rule Engine

Define when to send a coupon:
– Select 1 trigger product → If purchased → send email
– Select 1 target product → Suggested in email with discount

📩 Email Designer

  • Custom subject, heading, content, and footer
  • Dynamic personalization tags:
    • {{first_name}}
    • {{last_name}}
    • {{coupon_code}}
    • {{discount_amount}}
    • {{target_product_name}}

🧪 Built-in Tools

  • “Test Email” button (sends without affecting orders)
  • Sandbox mode (optional)
  • WooCommerce Select2-enhanced product selector

🧱 Clean UI & UX

  • Collapsible rule cards
  • Minimal and intuitive settings page
  • Compatible with WooCommerce 7–8+

💎 Upgrade to Pro

Unlock the full power of CrossSell Mailer:

  • Unlimited rules & products
  • Category & cart-based conditions
  • Customer segment filters
  • Advanced email templates
  • Scheduled & delayed emails
  • Analytics & conversion tracking
  • Priority support

👉 Learn more or upgrade: https://sellmailer.com

Support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly from the WordPress Plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Coupon Rules to create your first automation rule.
  4. Select a trigger product and a target product.
  5. Customize the automatic coupon and the post-purchase email template.
  6. (Optional) Use the Send Test Email feature to preview the email.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work with any WooCommerce product type?

Yes. Simple, variable, and subscription products are supported.

Can I create more than one rule?

The Lite version allows one rule. You can upgrade to CrossSell Mailer Pro for unlimited rules.

Can I send delayed emails?

Delayed and scheduled emails are available in the Pro version.

Are custom email templates supported?

Yes. You can edit the subject, heading, content, and footer. Pro adds advanced templates.

Can I test the email without making a purchase?

Yes. Use the “Send Test Email” button in the rule editor.

Does this plugin affect existing WooCommerce emails?

No. It creates its own dedicated post-purchase automation flow.
